title: Govern system prompt and model config in managed pages, not loose files
description: Replace loose-file prompt/config handling with governed, first-class configuration surfaces. Move model configuration into a dedicated managed page and expose it in the app so changes are visible, reviewable, and auditable.

comments.author: Themasonx
comments.body: This should be renamed later and the description fixed, but the system prompt shouldn't be a loose file, but rather something governed within the system. Move the models configuration out to its own page and expose this
